title: Service fulfilment
subtitle: Track services to provide after a confirmed payment, their preparation and their fulfilment evidence.
scope: By default, current approved preparations appear first. Promised services still awaiting preparation remain upcoming, subject to completing and approving the dossier preparation.
emptyTitle: No promised services in this selection
empty: Change the filters or return after a payment is confirmed and the sponsorship commitments are recorded.

destination.dossier: Promised services for the linked dossier
destination.choose: Choose the promised service to view from the list.
destination.invalid: This link does not identify a valid dossier and promised service.
destination.empty: No accessible promised service matches this link. Commitments must be recorded before they appear here.

errors.error: Services could not be loaded. Try again to get the current data.
errors.forbidden: Your session does not allow you to view services.
errors.unavailable: Services are temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

detail.title: Promised service details
detail.choose: Select a promised service to see its preparation, content and fulfilment evidence.
detail.preparationHelp: Current dossier checks determine the next preparation step.
detail.previewScope: This preview shows the text associated with the promised service. View the image and final layout in their publication workspace.
detail.unknownReason: Open the dossier to examine the next step.
detail.noContent: No content is associated with this publication. Open the publication dossier to continue preparing it.
detail.authorization: An approved preparation does not authorize publication. The exact content, destination and schedule require their own authorization.
detail.evidenceScope: The evidence records delivery of this promised service. Visibility depends on the latest dated observation.
detail.noObservation: No dated observation is available. Current visibility still needs verification.
detail.agreementScope: Agreement version associated with this evidence: not specified.
detail.noProof: No qualified evidence for this promised service. Follow-up remains open until delivery is confirmed.
detail.adjusted: A waiver was recorded for this promised service. It does not constitute delivery.

responsibility.none: No remaining action for this promised service.
